summary: Implement guarded host bootstrap and lifecycle
description: Apply an approved deployment bundle to an authorized host: provision prerequisites and directories, pull images, place protected runtime files, start services, and manage restart lifecycle with rollback.
acceptance: Bootstrap executes only an approved, current deployment plan against one exact host identity and rejects stale preflight, changed bundles, host mismatch, or missing authority.
Package installation, directory creation, image pull, protected file placement, Compose startup, and restart enablement are allowlisted, bounded, attributed, and independently read back.
Existing configuration is backed up before replacement; partial failure stops safely and exposes an exact rollback or recovery state without broad cleanup.
No credential, private host identifier, Compose environment value, or remote command output enters public evidence or exception chains.
